name: GiocAosta Cube Open 2024
information:
The competition is part of [GiocAosta](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SanMarinoNationals2023#26634-san-marino-game-convention).
**Note: you will have to pay 10€ extra at the venue if you are not a Cubing Italy member.**
Membership is free! More info in the [Registration tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SanMarinoNationals2023#26011-registration-registrazione-faq).

---
